speaker: Doctor
text: The history of bipolar disorder and current lithium use is a crucial detail, as lithium can induce polyuria. Given your symptoms of frequency, suprapubic pain relieved by voiding, and dyspareunia, along with the need to rule out structural abnormalities, what is the result of the Pelvic Ultrasound we requested, and has the Urinalysis confirmed the absence of bacteria or white blood cells?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis (Painful Bladder Syndrome).
